name: Viridescent-Dolmen
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in towering mountain ranges. Travelers navigate by a subterranean ocean and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Herds of six-limbed graziers shadow the meltwater margins, wary of anything that walks upright.
Around the radiation hotspot, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
